ankle_roll_stop.geometry: 2 x 7075 stop blocks 20x12x10 mm on the ankle cross (±roll), contact face at r 45 mm, faces strike foot-fork shoulders; 2 mm PU 95A pad bonded on each face; 1 x M4x10 + dowel per block

thigh_pin_panel.outline_mm: front (x+) panel 60 w x 70 h, R8 corners, centred on collar mid-height; matching rear 40x50 exit window
thigh_pin_panel.pins: 2 x ø6 x 62 42CrMo4, x-axis, z ±8.5 from collar mid [EST layout]

access.front_clear_mm: ≥25 free in front of pin heads (cover 3 mm off collar OD ø64 → ~35 mm to fairing inner wall)
access.rear_push_out_mm: pin exits rear through 40x50 window, ≥62 mm needed, ≥70 available behind collar to the seat/hip envelope [EST]
access.tool: ø5 pin punch L≥72 mm + 200 g hammer, or M3 extractor thread

thigh_pin_panel.fasteners: front 4 x M3 captive quarter-turn (Southco-type) [EST]; rear 2 x M3
